name: Jerusalem
about: Spring and fall are mild and ideal for walking the old city, summer is hot and dry, winter can bring rare snow and rain.
overview: Three religions' holiest sites within the Old City's walls, and a modern, fast-growing city just outside them.
costOverview: Street food and transit are inexpensive — museum and site admission fees are where the real costs add up.
